evidence.ACL: Interstitial hyperintense signal of ACL, in favor of grade 1 injury.
evidence.MCL: partial disruption of the ligament, in favor of grade 2 injury.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: No evidence of tear is noted in either medial or lateral meniscus in this study.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: No evidence of tear is noted in either medial or lateral meniscus in this study.
evidence.Effusion: Joint effusion and suprapatellar bursitis of left knee
evidence.Synovitis: hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.
evidence.Contusion: Bone marrow edema in the anterior aspect of proximal tibia, the fibular head, and the lateral femoral condyle, R/O bone contusion.
